name: Engagement letter: foreign bank account report (FinCEN Form 114)

blocks.text: {Date}
{Signer name}
Dear {Signer first names}:

{Firm name} (“firm,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is pleased to provide {Client name} (“you” or “your”) with the professional services described below. Please read this letter, the attached Terms and Conditions Addendum and any other attachments incorporated herein (collectively, “Agreement”). This Agreement details the nature and limitations of the services we will provide, the terms of our engagement and each party’s responsibilities.
Engagement Objective and Scope
The objective of our services is the preparation and electronic filing of the following report for the year ended [Date]:

items: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (“FinCEN”) Form 114, Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (“FBAR”)

blocks.text: The objective of our services is to assist you with the reporting of your foreign bank and financial accounts and provide you with forms and schedules we believe are suitable for you to file with FinCEN and sufficient to comply with your filing obligations. You have the final responsibility for the filing and content of your report(s). To the extent a report can be e-filed, we will provide assistance with the e-filing of such report as further discussed in this Agreement. We will not assist you with any reports, tax forms or tax returns other than those identified above, without your written request, and our written agreement to do so.

This informational report is not a tax return nor is the related filing requirement part of filing an income tax return. It is a report filed with FinCEN, an agency of the U.S. Department of the Treasury, in compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act. FinCEN may share the information in this report with other federal and state agencies, including the Internal Revenue Service (“IRS”). We cannot answer questions about use of the FBAR by agencies other than FinCEN. All such questions should be directed to your attorney for response prior to authorizing us to file the FBAR on your behalf.

The information you provide to us (as delineated under Client Responsibilities below) may identify related IRS tax filing requirements applicable to you such as Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Assets, Form 1116, Foreign Tax Credit, and/or Form 1118, Foreign Tax Credit – Corporations. The determination of whether these forms are required is not within the scope of this engagement. Failure to file required forms may result in the imposition of civil and criminal penalties, and the loss of income tax credits or deductions available for use on your U.S. income tax returns.

Our engagement does not include any procedures designed to detect errors, fraud, theft, or other wrongdoing. Therefore, our engagement cannot be relied upon to disclose such matters. If we identify or suspect that an instance of noncompliance with laws and regulations has occurred or is likely to occur, we will discuss the matter with the appropriate level of management and, when appropriate, those charged with governance. In addition, we are not responsible for identifying or communicating deficiencies in your internal controls, unless otherwise specified in the scope of this Agreement. You are responsible for developing and implementing internal controls applicable to your operations.

Requests for additional services may necessitate that we amend the Agreement or issue a separate written agreement to reflect the obligations of all parties. In the absence of any other written communications from us documenting additional services, our services will be limited to and governed by the terms of this Agreement.
CPA Firm Responsibilities

It is our duty to prepare your FBAR based upon the same standard of care expected of professional service providers who routinely prepare and submit FBAR reports to FinCEN. Unless otherwise noted, the applicable standard of care for this engagement shall be consistent with guidance and pronouncements issued by the U.S. Department of Treasury and FinCEN as relates solely to FBAR compliance.
We will not update your reports after the conclusion of the engagement for any reason unless further engaged.
{Firm name} will not make any management decisions or perform management functions on your behalf.
Prior year review

Our review of the prior year’s report will necessarily be limited and may not find errors. We will, however, bring to your attention errors that we do find. Similarly, if you become aware of any information affecting prior year reports, please contact us. If an error or information affecting prior year reports is discovered by you or us, we will discuss your options with you. If you ask us to prepare an amended report, and we agree, we will confirm this engagement in a separate written agreement.
Tax planning services

Our engagement does not include tax advice which affects the calculation of tax due or the filing of tax forms and schedules for previous or future tax years. However, we may communicate potential tax planning opportunities to you, and you may ask high-level questions of us. It is your responsibility to communicate to us, in writing, any interest in pursuing a tax planning opportunity identified, or if you require more than a cursory response to your question. If you do not request our assistance in writing, we will infer that you do not wish to pursue any suggestion made to you. If you do request our assistance and we agree, we will confirm our understanding with you in a separate written agreement prior to proceeding.

We shall not be liable for any tax, penalties, interest, related professional fees, or other expenses you may incur if you fail to advise us of your desire to investigate or pursue any tax planning opportunity communicated to or by us. Any tax advice described in this paragraph and provided to you shall be governed by this Agreement and billed at our standard hourly rates.
Government inquiries

This engagement does not include responding to inquiries by any governmental agency or tax authority. If you are contacted by a governmental agency, either for an examination or other inquiry, you may request our assistance in responding.
Third party requests

Our services are not intended to benefit or influence any third party, including any entity or investment which may seek to evaluate your creditworthiness or financial strength. We will not respond to any request from banks, mortgage brokers or others for verification of any information reported on these reports. Except where compelled by court order or subpoena, we do not communicate with third parties or provide them with copies of reports.
Reliance on others
If you wish to report information based upon the advice of another advisor, before we are able to sign your report, we must comply with Treasury guidance related to FBARs.

We will review the other advisor’s work and may require a written statement from the advisor describing the basis for the reporting. If we believe additional research is required, we will discuss the matter with you and obtain your written consent to perform such research. You agree to pay for the additional charges necessary to complete the disclosure or research as this is not included in the scope of this Agreement.

Moreover, you understand that the Treasury or government agencies may disagree with the information contained in or omitted from your report. If this occurs, we shall not be liable for any tax, penalties, interest, related professional fees, or other expenses you may incur.
If, after review of the work prepared by your other advisor, we determine that we are unable to sign the report, we will be unable to proceed.
Client Responsibilities

If you fail to comply with the responsibilities as described in this Agreement, your actions or your inactions may result in economic or other loss to you, such as penalties or interest assessed against you, loss of administrative rights, or criminal punishment. You will be responsible for any loss suffered by you, including any professional fees required to defend or correct changes made to your report, prepare previously unfiled reports, or amend previously filed reports. The responsibilities detailed in this section are not exhaustive, and our services to you may require additional responsibilities not listed.
Report information

**Due to the high volume of tax returns prepared by our firm, you** **must** **provide your information to us no later than [Date]. Failure to do so may result in your inability to file your report by the original filing due date.**

You are responsible for informing us of all foreign financial assets and interests, including any financial interest in, or signature authority over assets, or financial accounts located in a foreign country. This information includes but is not limited to savings accounts, checking accounts, current accounts, securities accounts, custodial accounts, certificates of deposit, time deposits, mutual funds, digital assets, annuities, insurance policies with cash surrender values, retirement accounts, and pension accounts. In addition, please inform us if you have either (1) any direct or indirect ownership interest in an entity or company located in or organized under the laws of a foreign country or (2) signature authority over any financial accounts of such foreign entity. Please disclose all items that may possibly fall within this broad definition. You are responsible for asking us if you have any questions about what is required to be reported.

We will rely upon the completeness and accuracy of the information and representations you provide to us. Our responsibility is limited to the information of which we have knowledge. We will not audit or otherwise verify the data you submit to us, although we may ask you to clarify certain information.
Communication of authority of others

You hereby authorize the following individuals from {Client name} to communicate directly with us on your behalf, and to request services and exchange information necessary to provide the services described in this Agreement:
Name     Title    Contact Information

You agree that this limited authority conveyed above shall continue in full force and effect until either this Agreement is concluded, or you inform us of any modifications in writing, whichever occurs first.
Online access to information

To the extent you provide our firm with access to electronic data via a local or online database from which we will download your trial balance or other information, you agree that the data is accurate as of the date and time you make it available to be downloaded by us.
Documentation

You are responsible for maintaining adequate documentation to substantiate the accuracy and completeness of your FBAR. Our workpapers do not satisfy your documentation responsibility. You should retain all documents that provide evidence and support for reported balances on your FBAR, as required under applicable laws and regulations.
You represent that you have such documentation and can produce it, if necessary, to respond to any examination or inquiry by FinCEN or other authorities.
We shall not be liable for any tax, civil or criminal penalties, interest, related professional fees, or other expenses you may incur as a result of inadequate documentation.
Foreign filing obligations

You are responsible for complying with the tax filing requirements of any non-U.S. country. You acknowledge and agree that we have no responsibility to raise these issues with you and that any foreign filing obligation is not within the scope of this Agreement.
Digital assets

There are specific tax implications of investing in digital assets (e.g., virtual currencies, non-fungible tokens, virtual real estate and similar assets). If you held digital assets during the tax year, you may have reporting obligations associated with such transactions. You are responsible for providing us with complete and accurate information regarding any digital assets held during the applicable tax year. This Agreement does not include assisting you with such tax implications and reporting obligations unrelated to the preparation of FBAR.
Ultimate responsibility

You are ultimately responsible for complying with any substantive or procedural law which applies to you, and for ensuring your reports are timely received by the appropriate authority. Notwithstanding any term of this Agreement, this responsibility cannot be delegated to us.

Our assistance related to your report is based upon reference materials, facts, assumptions, and representations that are subject to change. Reference materials include, but are not limited to, FinCEN guidance, the Internal Revenue Code, Revenue Rulings, Revenue Procedures, court cases, and similar state and local guidance. To the extent we provide written advice concerning federal tax matters, we will follow the applicable guidance contained in our professional standards.

You have final responsibility for the accuracy of your FBAR. We will provide you with a copy of your draft FBAR and accompanying schedules and statements for review. You agree to review and examine it carefully for accuracy and completeness. Failure to file an FBAR when required, or to fully and accurately disclose all information requested in the report, may result in the imposition of civil or criminal penalties, and interest charges on unpaid penalties. Additionally, if you have income earned outside of the United States, additional tax, penalty and interest charges can be assessed by the IRS and other tax authorities on such income if it is not reported on your income tax returns. These penalties and related interest charges may be significant. We shall not be liable for any tax, penalties, interest, related professional fees, or other expenses that may be imposed by regulatory authorities.
Timing of the Engagement
We expect to begin our services upon receipt of this executed Agreement and signed IRC §7216 consent and retainer, and all information and documents necessary to prepare the report.
Our services under this Agreement will conclude:

items: upon the filing and acceptance of your {Tax year} FBAR by FinCEN;
upon written notification by either party that the Agreement is terminated; or
one (1) year from the execution date of this Agreement, whichever comes first.

blocks.text: Filing Your Report

The original filing due date for the FBAR is April 15, {Tax year}. The obligation to file a report is solely yours. Although we will make every reasonably prudent effort to assist you with this obligation, this Agreement is not intended to and does not create an agent/principal relationship. By signing this Agreement, you understand that actual and timely receipt of your filings by the appropriate authority is the duty and responsibility of you and you alone.
Extensions
The time to file an FBAR is automatically extended for six (6) months to October 15, {Tax year}.
E-filing
The e-filing of any form is a separate service from the preparation of that form.

FinCEN requires you to sign and return to us the appropriate governmental form(s) before your report(s) can be filed electronically. **If you fail to timely sign and return e-file authorizations, we cannot and will not e-file** **any** **form on your behalf.** In those situations, we shall not be liable for any tax, penalties, interest, related professional fees, or other expenses you may incur.
Professional Fee

Our professional fee for the services outlined above is estimated to be {Fee}, of which [X]% is due upon execution of this Agreement as a retainer. This fee is based upon the complexity of the expected work to be performed, regulatory or government deadline sensitivity, our professional time and out-of-pocket expenses, and overall value of the services provided.

Circumstances may arise that impact our estimated fee such as, but not limited to, (1) the timeliness, accuracy, or completeness of information you provide to us; (2) changes in your personnel, use of other advisors, or operations that impact our services; (3) mutually agreed changes in the scope of this engagement; or (4) other unanticipated items that arise during our engagement and that require additional time in order to complete the agreed-upon services.
You agree to pay all fees and expenses incurred whether or not we complete the engagement.

We appreciate the opportunity to be of service to you. This Agreement, including the Terms and Conditions Addendum, represents the entire agreement of the parties relating to the services that are the subject of this Agreement. This Agreement supersedes all previous agreements, negotiations, representations, or other understandings, whether oral or written, between the parties.

Any modification to the terms of this Agreement must be made in writing and signed by both parties. Please date and execute this Agreement and return it to us to acknowledge your acceptance. We will not initiate services until we receive the executed Agreement and retainer.
{Terms and Conditions}
Very truly yours,
{Firm name}
/s/ {Partner name}
{Partner title}
